heritage.title: Our Story
heritage.paragraph1: In the heart of Abruzzo, among the gentle hills of the province of Pescara, lies the G.B. Obletter Farm: a project born from the vision of a young entrepreneur who chose to look to the future by rediscovering the most authentic roots of the land.
heritage.paragraph2: Giovanni Battista Obletter, born in 1996, represents a new generation of farmers who combines centuries-old peasant wisdom with the most advanced sustainable cultivation practices. Fifty hectares of land spread across Cepagatti, Moscufo and Pianella — villages where time still moves to the rhythm of the seasons — form the green heritage from which our certified organic products are born.
heritage.sectionTwoP1Mid2: , an ancient Italian variety almost forgotten by intensive agriculture, tells our philosophy: recovering the best of the past to offer the present a genuine and conscious diet. From the same passion comes our
heritage.sectionTwoP1Mid3: DOP Aprutino Pescarese Extra Virgin Olive Oil
heritage.sectionTwoP1End: , cold-pressed from olives hand-picked in the olive groves that have dotted this landscape for generations.
heritage.sectionTwoP2: Every product that bears our name is the result of a daily commitment to quality, sustainability and respect for a land that has taught us everything. Because being young farmers today means having the courage to innovate, without ever forgetting where we come from.
